prompt.project_info: Natural photorealistic 9:16 close-up portrait taken directly overhead during golden hour on an outdoor Los Angeles Walk of Fame-style sidewalk, with warm soft afternoon light and social-media candid aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with shoulder-length dark hair in a ponytail, fair skin with natural freckles across the nose, cheeks and forehead, light brown eyes with long dark lashes, natural brows and soft mauve-red lips. She wears a pink off-shoulder sleeveless top with ribbed texture and ruffle details, a short denim skirt, multiple gold rings, small gold hoop earrings and a gold chain with a ruby pendant. Do not reproduce Sydney Sweeney or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Kneel or sit on charcoal terrazzo pavement with both hands resting naturally on the knees and look straight up at the overhead camera with a soft neutral expression. Frame head, shoulders and hands in a close-up while keeping a gold star visible beneath or beside her. Use the rule of thirds and a clean social-media composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm golden-hour sunlight casts a diagonal shadow across the pavement, with natural outdoor contrast and gentle highlights on freckles, hair and jewelry. Keep the atmosphere intimate, candid, warm and natural, without studio lighting or heavy makeup.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 overhead smartphone or mirrorless portrait, close-up head-shoulders-hands framing, realistic skin, hair, ribbed fabric, denim, terrazzo and jewelry texture, natural golden-hour color, no text, logo or watermark.
